name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixed plugin updates silently not applying. The project file's AssemblyVersion/FileVersion were left hardcoded at 0.0.63 since that release, even though meta.json's version kept getting bumped (0.0.64, 0.0.65) - Jellyfin identifies a loaded plugin by its assembly's actual embedded version, not the folder name or meta.json, so every DLL shipped since 0.0.63 was invisible to Jellyfin as a real update. Installing 0.0.64 or 0.0.65 would download successfully and even show as a new folder on disk, but after a restart Jellyfin kept loading it as (and reporting it as) version 0.0.63 - which is what "the plugin won't update" actually was. AssemblyVersion/FileVersion now stay in lockstep with the release version.

198 tests.
